name: Morning flow
description: A gentle 10 minute wake-up that moves the spine, hips and shoulders through their full range. No equipment, easy enough to do every day.

items.cue: Move with your breath: inhale to arch, exhale to round.
Let the shoulder melt down, hips stay over knees.
Pedal your heels and push the floor away.
Sink the hips, then rotate and follow your hand.
Heels down, elbows nudge the knees out.
No weight. Roll down one vertebra at a time.
Shoulders away from ears, lift only as high as is easy.
Sink the hips back and breathe into your back.
Reach long through the fingertips, do not lean forward.
Big slow circles, change direction halfway.
Start small and grow the circles.
